question: What is the parent technique of attack technique 'T1090.004: Proxy: Domain Fronting'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
Found ATT&CK record T1090.004: Domain Fronting. T1090.004 (Domain Fronting): Adversaries may take advantage of routing schemes in Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) and other services which host multiple domains to obfuscate the intended destination of HTTPS traffic or traffic tunneled through HTTPS. (Citation: Fifield Blocking Resistent Communication through domain fronting 2015) Domain fronting involves using different domain names in the SNI field of the TLS header and the Host field of the HTTP header. If both domains are served from the same CDN, then the CDN may route to the address specified in the HTTP header after unwrapping the TLS header.
